issues.detail: The Greek 'ει εκεινους ειπεν θεους' means 'if He called those [people] gods'. The Vietnamese translation 'gọi những kẻ được lời Đức Chúa Trời đến là các thần' adds the phrase 'được lời Đức Chúa Trời đến' (who came by/to the word of God), which is not present in the Greek text.
The Greek 'προς ους' (to whom) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation. The Greek structure implies 'if He called those [people] gods to whom the word of God became...'
